entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
I need to return the VeloBand I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for one VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 4th. That makes it 15 days ago. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I just don't want it. It's still in the box.

I see. For the VeloBand Pulse model specifically, our return policy is within 10 days of delivery. Since we're on day 15, a return based on preference is outside of that window. The policy is strict because the device activation links the hardware to a user account.
Of course it is. How convenient for you. It's a little hard to try a fitness tracker from a hospital bed.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I wasn't aware of the circumstances. We do have exceptions for medical situations. Can you tell me what happened?

I had an emergency appendectomy. Required unexpected surgery. I was in the hospital for over a week and I've just been recovering at home. On top of that, my brother who was going to help me is on military deployment, so it's just been a whole thing.

Thank you for sharing that with me, and I truly hope you are on the mend. An emergency surgery absolutely qualifies for a policy exception. I can authorize a one-time full refund for you right away. I really appreciate you clarifying the situation.
Oh. Okay. A refund is fine.

Excellent. I'm processing that for you now. You'll receive a pre-paid return label in your email within the next hour. The full refund will be issued to your original payment method once the item is received back at our warehouse. And because you're a VIP member and given the trouble you've been through, I've also added a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account for any future needs. My apologies again for the difficult experience.
Whatever. The credit is fine. Thanks, I guess.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, I wish you a very speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
